        10       Bruno:

        11                  "I would appreciate the privilege

        16       personally deliver an address to the members

        17       of the Legislature.

         9       message from the Governor.

        10                  "RESOLVED, That the Senate and

        11       Assembly meet in joint session in the Assembly

        13       purpose of receiving a message from the

        14       Governor."

        16       question is on the resolution.  All in favor

        17       signify by saying aye.
